partners.mechanism_chain: VHL (HGNC:12445) —DISRUPTS→ HIF1-alpha regulation (GO:0000143); HIF1-alpha regulation (GO:0000143) —DECREASES→ Wnt signaling pathway (REACT:R-HSA-569276); APC (HGNC:546) —DISRUPTS→ Wnt signaling pathway (REACT:R-HSA-569276); CTNNB1 (HGNC:2515) —INCREASES→ Wnt signaling pathway (REACT:R-HSA-569276); Wnt signaling pathway (REACT:R-HSA-569276) —LEADS_TO→ Neoplasia (HP:0002664); Wnt signaling pathway (REACT:R-HSA-569276) —LEADS_TO→ Colorectal cancer (MONDO:0005575). Loss of VHL function in von Hippel-Lindau disease leads to stabilization of HIF-1alpha, which in turn can lead to downregulation of tumor suppressors and aberrant activation of the Wnt signaling pathway.
